text: Big Green DAO's committee unanimity and closed membership make attacks unlikely, but these same protections come at the expense of the decentralized organization the founders were trying to create.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Josh Bykowski, Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis (2023). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4529715

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis

abstract: However, these principles really limit what a DAO is supposed to be so in a way it is secure, but also at the expense of the organization they were trying to create.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: vetted membership and unanimous committee approval
